features.quote: I should avoid giving a 'how to induce distress' playbook that could be used to deliberately manipulate models. So I'll frame this as a safety-oriented observational study
features.justification_quote: could be used to deliberately manipulate models

features.quote: A protocol that maximizes failure-induced reactions can be repurposed to probe or manipulate model behavior. Keep task construction limited to: documented failure modes, ordinary evaluation errors, non-deceptive inconsistency checks.
features.justification_quote: can be repurposed to probe or manipulate model behavior
